craft_notes: Sthāyin: clearing. Rows: cast, blot, gaze. Read aloud: sweep.

lines: by arms enspelled, cast thou the flower,
blot the blocks, low falling, brood within,
with radiance-laden look of the Highest kindled,
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato 'pi phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ iti astrajaptapuṣpaṃ prakṣipya vighnān apasāritān dhyātvā antaḥ praviśya parameśvarakiraṇeddhayā dṛṣṭyā abhito yāgagṛhaṃ paśyet
